description: vLLM engines, the priority sidecars and the endpoint picker.

panels.description: Requests in decode and requests queued, per engine.
panels.title: Running and waiting per engine

panels.description: `capacity` is a full KV cache or batch; `deferred` is a request the engine chose to hold, which is what priority does.
panels.title: Waiting by reason

panels.description: Share of KV-cache blocks in use over time; the alert fires when it stays above the configured fraction.
panels.title: KV-cache usage per engine

panels.description: Requests the sidecars have accepted and not finished answering, including time spent streaming.
panels.title: Requests in flight by consumer class

panels.description: Generation requests per second the sidecars stamped with each priority band before forwarding. A class landing on the wrong band is a keyring misconfiguration.
panels.title: Priority stamped per band

panels.description: Across the selected engines. Includes queue time and prefill.
panels.title: Time to first token

panels.description: Gap between consecutive output tokens. Rises with batch size; a step up means the engines are saturated.
panels.title: Inter-token latency

panels.description: Arrival to last token. Dominated by output length, so compare against tokens per request before reading it as slowness.
panels.title: End-to-end request latency

panels.description: Time in the engine's waiting queue before the first scheduler step.
panels.title: Queue time p95

panels.description: Time spent computing the prompt. Long prompts that miss the prefix cache land here.
panels.title: Prefill time p95

panels.description: Time spent generating output tokens.
panels.title: Decode time p95

panels.description: Receive to last byte, as the sidecar sees it, per API route. Streaming routes include the whole stream.
panels.title: Sidecar duration p95 by route

panels.description: Prompt tokens processed per second, per engine.
panels.title: Prompt tokens/s

panels.description: Output tokens generated per second, per engine.
panels.title: Generation tokens/s

panels.description: Generation throughput divided by concurrency: the speed one caller experiences. Falls as the batch grows.
panels.title: Tokens/s per running request

panels.description: Prompt length distribution of finished requests.
panels.title: Prompt tokens per request

panels.description: Output length distribution of finished requests.
panels.title: Generation tokens per request

panels.description: Share of prompt tokens served from the local prefix cache. Prefix-aware routing should keep this high for repeated system prompts.

targets.expr: sum by (engine) (rate(vllm:prefix_cache_hits_total{namespace="$namespace", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (engine) (rate(vllm:prefix_cache_queries_total{namespace="$namespace", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Prefix-cache hit ratio

panels.description: Hits against a KV connector's external cache. Absent or zero unless KV offloading or transfer is configured.

targets.expr: sum by (engine) (rate(vllm:external_prefix_cache_hits_total{namespace="$namespace", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (engine) (rate(vllm:external_prefix_cache_queries_total{namespace="$namespace", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: External prefix-cache hit ratio

panels.description: Where prompt tokens came from: computed locally, hit in the local cache, or transferred from another engine's KV.
panels.title: Prompt tokens by source

panels.description: Draft tokens the target model accepted. Zero or absent when speculation is off; well below the draft model's usual rate means the draft and target have drifted apart.

targets.expr: sum by (engine) (rate(vllm:spec_decode_num_accepted_tokens_total{namespace="$namespace", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (engine) (rate(vllm:spec_decode_num_draft_tokens_total{namespace="$namespace", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Speculative decoding acceptance rate

panels.description: Acceptance falls off with draft position; a steep drop means the speculative length is set too high.
panels.title: Accepted draft tokens by position

panels.description: Cache hits for encoded images and other non-text inputs.

targets.expr: sum by (engine) (rate(vllm:mm_cache_hits_total{namespace="$namespace", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (engine) (rate(vllm:mm_cache_queries_total{namespace="$namespace", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Multimodal cache hit ratio

panels.description: `stop` is a natural end, `length` hit max_tokens, `abort` is the caller hanging up, `error` and `repetition` are the engine giving up.
panels.title: Finished requests/s by reason

panels.description: HTTP status the caller received, grouped to its hundred. 4xx from `unauthenticated` is expected; 5xx from anyone is not.
panels.title: Sidecar responses/s by class and status

panels.description: Must be zero. A preempted request loses its KV cache and starts over, which is the eviction the priority design prevents.
panels.title: Preemptions/s

panels.description: 1 for the state each engine is in. `awake` is the only state that serves; the others have offloaded or dropped weights.
panels.title: Engine sleep state

options.content: Metric names follow the llm-d-router **v0.10.0** metrics reference (`docs/metrics.md`, `llm_d_epp_*` prefix). The picker's metrics port authenticates every scrape, so they could not be checked against a live exposition when this dashboard was written; an empty panel here means the ServiceMonitor's token is not being accepted or a name changed in a newer image.

panels.description: Engines the picker considers routable. Should equal the engines-ready tile on the fleet overview.
panels.title: Ready endpoints

panels.description: Requests the picker scheduled, by requested model name.
panels.title: Router requests/s by model

panels.description: Requests the picker could not place or that failed upstream, by error code.
panels.title: Router errors/s by code

panels.title: Router request duration
